title: What Can We Do? - Mit Tudunk Csinálni?
grammar: tud/lehet/szabad combined; -hat/-het as a one-word preview of "may/can"

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can combine tud, lehet, and szabad in one conversation about plans, choosing the right one for ability, possibility, or permission.
I can recognize a few common -hat/-het forms, like mehetek, as a one-word alternative to lehet + infinitive.
